description: Founder and investor ownership across several future funding rounds, including option pool top-ups before each round. Use option_pool for a single round when the question is how a pre-money pool shifts value, and startup_valuation for one simple round. Interactive version: https://raziel.co/tools/dilution-calculator

founders_pct.description: Founders’ combined ownership today, percent of fully diluted shares.

option_pool_pct.description: Unissued option pool today, percent of fully diluted shares. Anything not founders or pool is treated as existing investors.

raise_usd.description: New money raised in the round.

target_pool_pct.description: Target unissued pool after the round, percent of post-money. 0 for no top-up.
